maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is outsourced customer support, content moderation and AI data services for tech clients, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private companies such as Meta, Chime and Wix paying for outsourced digital services.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically by expanding delivery centers and client programs; website mentions no regular acquisition stream.

mission_critical.reason: Embedded outsourced support, trust and safety, and AI operations; switching means retraining, transition risk and service disruption.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgement call, since BPO providers can be replaced with some effort.
